name: Promptfoo
what_it_does: YAML-configured evaluation harness for LLM prompts and applications. Supports test cases, assertions, redteaming plugins, and side-by-side model comparison; integrates well with CI for regression evaluation and with both local and hosted model endpoints.
what_it_doesnt_do: Not a guardrail enforcement product (it tests, it does not block at runtime). Some of the deeper agentic testing features are part of the paid tier; the OSS version is excellent for prompt-level eval but less complete for multi-tool agent assessments.
best_for: Application teams building regression-evaluable LLM features
Comparing model providers/versions for the same use case
Red teamers wanting structured, repeatable test runs from YAML
not_for: Teams that prefer all-Python over YAML configuration ergonomics
pricing_summary: Free OSS core; paid tier for enterprise features.
team_skill_required: Comfortable with YAML config; basic CLI; helpful but not required: JS familiarity for custom assertions.
